<!-- Short release notes the Daeva Discord bot posts when a release is published.
     Update "version" and the lists with each release. -->
version: 0.6.0
tagline: Pet Insight on your meter: watch every kill count towards your pets, and see the crystals from the ones you've maxed.

## New
- 🐾 **Pet progress:** a strip under the monster card shows the pet it counts towards, its level and kills (13/25), with a +1 on every kill
- 💎 **Crystals from maxed pets:** a maxed pet shows a paw and MAX, with a crystal +1 when one drops
- 🎴 **Pets in Solo:** the Solo card shows your pet right in the boss line
- 🦉 **New family icons** on the monster card
- 🔑 **Dimensional Invasion keys:** the alert shows how many keys you hold

## Fixed
- 🌪️ The Elementalist's Earth Spirit and Wind Spirit skills had each other's names
- 🥚 The Ore Insectoid Egg shows its name instead of "Unknown monster"
